Frame_1: The curry appears to be in its initial stages of cooking. The ingredients in the pot are partially submerged in liquid, hinting at a simmering process. The consistency at this point looks more broth-like, with visible solids and pieces floating around. There's a notable translucence to the liquid, suggesting that the curry hasn't thickened or fully integrated its components yet.
Frame_2: In this frame, the curry seems to have progressed further in the cooking process. The liquid content appears to have reduced slightly, giving the mixture a denser look. The ingredients are more pronounced and seem to be softening and integrating into the liquid. The color has also darkened a bit, indicating the amalgamation of spices and ingredients, and it exudes a richer appearance.
Frame_3: Here, the curry is visibly denser and has attained a thicker consistency. The ingredients within have softened significantly and have become an integral part of the curry. The simmering process seems to be at a more advanced stage, with the liquid bubbling gently. The overall hue of the curry is darker, and it looks rich and well-cooked, almost nearing its completion.
State_change_caption: From the first to the third frame, there is a noticeable transformation in the state of the curry. Initially starting as a lighter, broth-like mixture with distinct floating ingredients, it transitions into a denser, more cohesive dish. As the cooking progresses, the liquid content reduces, and the curry takes on a richer hue, signifying the melding of flavors and ingredients. By the third frame, the curry exhibits a thick, integrated consistency, with the ingredients softened and fully incorporated, indicating its near completion in the cooking process.
